tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted bands and table headers; never behind signal text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and fog (13:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface and surface-raised (5.7:1+).

tokens.name: elbe
tokens.usage: Brand navy: left half of the mark, headers, dark bands. Text on it is on-elbe.

tokens.name: on-elbe
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an elbe fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Pilot red: right half of the mark, primary action, active state; as text on surface or surface-raised (5:1+).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind signal text, selected rows.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Sparing accent for highlights, offsets and markers in diagrams; as text on surface (5:1+).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: State: healthy, committed, in sync. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: State: throttled, soft limit reached. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: State: error, hard limit, fenced. Same hue as signal, so it always carries an icon and a word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px gap in the page colour, then a 2px ring.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls, log-segment pill height in graphics.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact rows, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, log-segment pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The mark's corners (at 64px) and large feature blocks only.
